description: This file defines a RideState class for managing ride-related state in a Flutter application using ChangeNotifier. It includes getters and setters for distance, ride requests, destination address and coordinates, and current address, with change notifications.

classes.name: RideState
classes.description: A class that manages ride-related state such as distance, destination, and ride request status, extending ChangeNotifier to notify UI updates.

methods.name: setDistance
methods.description: Sets the trip distance and notifies listeners.

methods.name: requestRide
methods.description: Signals that a ride has been requested.

methods.name: setDestinationAddress
methods.description: Sets the destination address and notifies listeners.

methods.name: setDestinationCoords
methods.description: Sets the destination latitude and longitude, then notifies listeners.

methods.name: setCurrentAddress
methods.description: Sets the current user address and notifies listeners.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets all ride state fields to initial values and notifies listeners.
